# Local deletion coordinator fixture

Run only on a fresh disposable loopback backend, with ports 3480/3481 free and at least 2.5 GiB available. The script starts and stops its own backend, configures backend E2E telemetry off and an empty Boat key before sync, uses a verified macOS outbound-denying sandbox (loopback and local sockets allowed), rejects fetch redirects, and retains its logs and synthetic database in a new `/tmp/disposabl-local-deletion-*` directory. It uses the shared owned-process helper to terminate and reap the backend and sync/test process groups on interruption or if free space drops below 2.5 GiB. It requires a clean committed checkout, runs a retained commit snapshot, verifies copied auth bytes against the selected vendor archive, and verifies every copied MCP code file against `mcp-provenance.json`. That record was generated by checking the selected upstream tarball against the lockfile SHA-512, then applying the committed patch with zero fuzz. The runner rejects a different catalog version, lockfile integrity, patch path, patch content or installed file set. Bun installation tags are recorded but excluded from the package-code comparison. MCP physical-row instrumentation is confined to that copied component and hashed separately. Other cached dependency packages are referenced read-only, not independently frozen or audited. It requires the repository's installed dependencies, including the selected patched MCP and catalog-selected auth components; it does not install dependencies.

```sh
CONVEX_LOCAL_BINARY=/absolute/path/to/convex-local-backend \
  DO_NOT_TRACK=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 python3 packages/tests/fixtures/account-deletion-convex/local/run-local.py
```

The public fixture wrappers are synthetic and must never be deployed to an app backend. The test calls the real internal coordinator and its component mutations, directly reads the two deleted MCP grants/tokens and the 410 deleted ephemeral rows, checks another owner’s comparable records remain unchanged, and reconciles only a synthetic R2 metadata row without provider traffic. It does not prove remote drain, provider cleanup, historical orphans, completion, or production behavior.

The strengthened row/provenance/network proof supersedes the earlier progress-counter-only run and must be rerun before it is claimed as verified. It uses current auth progress only; no old-user migration is tested.

## MCP provenance regeneration

The current record describes `@convex-dev/mcp@0.1.0-alpha.7`: 98 files, upstream tarball 112,665 bytes. The tarball SHA-512 is recorded in `mcp-provenance.json` and must equal `bun.lock`. On a dependency or patch change, download the exact npm version outside the fixture, verify that digest before extraction, apply the selected patch using `patch --batch --fuzz=0 -p1`, and record SHA-256 for every resulting regular file relative to the package root. Update the version, upstream integrity, patch path and patch SHA-256 together. Do not generate expected hashes from the installed package. The fixture performs no download or installation.

The November 9 comparison used `/tmp/disposabl-mcp-alpha7-upstream-20261109.tgz` and retained the reconstructed package under `/tmp/disposabl-mcp-provenance-cafaof4s`. All 98 code files matched the installed component. This establishes the recorded component bytes only; the strengthened transaction run is still pending.
